{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for 'severe' in severity
print("Unique severity levels:", df['severity'].unique())

# Check for missing severity
print("Missing severity count:", df['severity'].isna().sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of duplicates (i.e. re-tests):", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check if any patient has missing severity
print("Patients with missing severity:", df[df['severity'].isna()]['patient_id'].unique())"}
